case: Murphy v. United Parcel Service, Inc.
form: One signed lead after plenary review, with six-Justice actual-disability construction/scope and regarded-as application, shared perceived-class framework and Supreme Court nonreach reservations, and six-Justice affirmance. Separate Stevens concurrence in part/dissent joined Breyer and Stone concurrence in part/dissent preserve different remedies.
form_legal_basis: Distinct coverage routes, legal mitigation construction versus ungranted treated-state sufficiency, and actual partial joins require severable sections; no part is divided to affect author counts.

governing_propositions.I: P1-P3 measures actually employed count, treated-state sufficiency outside grant, bounded guidance treatment. Six direct joins.
governing_propositions.II-A: P4 perceived-class-of-jobs framework only, no P5 application. Nine direct compatible joins.
governing_propositions.II-B: P5 insufficient breadth/perception proof on this record. Six direct joins.
governing_propositions.III: P6 Supreme nondecision of qualification/DOT defenses and their separation from coverage. Nine direct joins to nonreach/limits, no common remand position.
governing_propositions.IV: Affirm judgment, six votes; no Court remand.
governing_propositions.Stevens_Breyer: D1 untreated evidence taken true establishes actual disability; D2 reverse/remand for remaining issues. P4/P6 joins but no P5 application or alternative treated-state remand.
governing_propositions.Stone: Vacate coverage judgment and reassess without beneficial mitigation; preserved regarded-as elements and qualification/safety on remand. P4 framework/P6 Supreme nonreach joins only; no P2 or D1 final application.

assignment.pool_explanation: Chief does not assign; the senior participating Associate in the affirmance coalition assigns.
assignment.basis: Associate self-assignment inference grounded in her date-eligible Hazen Paper statutory distinctions and Caspari/Madsen question-scope opinions; she supports every proposition and can maintain the legal-rule/application boundary without expanding the grant. No historical authorship entitlement is used.
